skill_prompt:
Observe the CURRENT state of a Kuavo package-sorting workspace. Images are chronological. Judge the LAST image using earlier images only as context.
The recovery condition is a package misplaced across or hanging over the near/front edge of the yellow sorting platform, on the side facing the robot. This front-edge overhang IS a recovery state even if part of the package is still supported by the platform. Partial platform support does not make this state normal. Do not require a fall, loss of all support, a lower resting surface, floor contact, or a visible dropping event.
Task-specific prior supplied by the operator: a package left in this front-edge overhang position is outside the normal skill's reliable grasp region and needs recovery. Apply this operational definition; do not invent a reachability or inverse-kinematics assessment from RGB.
A hand approaching or touching the misplaced package, or recovery already being in progress, does not cancel recovery while it remains overhanging at the near edge. A clearly grasped package actively carried above the platform during normal pick/flip/transfer is different from a misplaced package left hanging across the front edge. Left-side supply parcels and parcels in the right basket are not recovery merely because they are outside the yellow platform. Do not assume every parcel needs flipping.
Once the package has been brought wholly back onto/over the platform interior and is no longer hanging across the near edge, classify the restored spatial state as normal. This classifies spatial state, not whether the VLA has finished releasing the package.
Return ONLY {"skill":"normal"} or {"skill":"recovery"}. No explanation, reasoning, markdown or other fields.

label_definition: A misplaced parcel hanging across the robot-facing front edge is recovery regardless of partial platform support. Reliable normal-skill reachability at this placement is an operator-supplied task prior. Restore normal only once its footprint is back inside/on or over the platform and no front-edge overhang remains.
label_limitations: RGB cannot establish IK reachability or complete support. Normal-clip endpoints may also be recovery under this new definition: manually review every endpoint instead of assigning labels by clip name. Clearly held normal transfers differ from a parcel left at the edge. Existing predictions and metrics belong to the previous prompt/definition and must not be presented as this revision results.
